text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High 5xx spike on api.redwood.ai -> 5xx rate 18% over 5m, 429s increasing, impacted routes: /v1/generate
pager-duty: Paging @ops-oncall @infra-eng
ops-oncall: I'm on it, ack
ops-oncall: Initial check - control-plane reports surge of 429s coming from rate-limiter service (rl-service) at region-us-west
infra-eng: seeing many upstream 524/gateway-timeout from gateway->model-proxy, correlation with rl-service OOM events
alex_m: any config change recently? I see a deploy to rl-service 10m ago
sylvia: yep I rolled a small hotfix to quota partitioning last deploy, intended to reduce token carryover. rolling back now.
ops-oncall: good call. I'm switching traffic to backup rate-limiter (rl-service-standby) via routing flag
incident-bot: deploy bot: rl-service rollback started by sylvia
bjorn: logs from rl-service before OOMs:
```
ERROR rate_limiter::tokens: failed to allocate pool
WARN request::handler: unexpected 429 response to gateway
```
infra-eng: gateway metrics show request queue depth spiked x10; backend model endpoints healthy but timing out behind overloaded gateway
ops-oncall: enabling circuit-breaker at api-gateway for heavy tenants (tenants: test-batch, corp-beta) to prevent fanout
customer-ops: asking for list of affected customers to notify; preliminary: corp-beta, integrum-svc, some internal test orgs
alex_m: I'm enabling temporary per-tenant soft-limits and increasing gateway worker threads by +30% in us-west
ops-oncall: running command: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment gateway-us-west --replicas=12` (was 9)
incident-bot: infra bot: scaled gateway-us-west to 12 replicas
infra-eng: after scale, queue depth halved, 5xx rate falling to ~6% but 429s still ~4%
sylvia: rollback complete, rl-service back to v1.14.3
ops-oncall: routing flag to rl-service-standby removed, traffic back to primary
bjorn: replays of rl-service logs show a pathological tenant requesting huge batch embeddings - created token storm and exhausted token buckets
alex_m: found tenant integrum-svc with misconfigured client retry loop causing retry storm; notified their account team
customer-ops: sent initial customer notification to integrum-svc and corp-beta: short blurb + ETA
customer-ops: "We're investigating elevated errors and have mitigations in place. We'll update in 30m." :phone:
ops-oncall: enabling fallback policy: when gateway sees 503/524 from model-proxy, route to lower-cost model variant (model-lite) for best-effort responses
infra-eng: applied fallback rule in traffic-router, verified via canary traffic
incident-bot: monitoring: 5xx down to 1.2% over 5m, timeouts rare, 429s steady ~0.7%
ops-oncall: marking incident as mitigated, keeping pager for 60m to watch for reoccurrence
alex_m: post-incident action items:
- 1) add tenant circuit-breaker to quota service
- 2) add retry-safety checks to client SDK
- 3) add alert to detect single-tenant token surge
sylvia: I'll draft the postmortem and include rolling rollback checklist + safer config deploy gating
customer-ops: prepping customer follow-up with timeline and root-cause
ops-oncall: thanks all. closing on-call handover to ops-oncall+infra-eng for monitoring window
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) at 4409990065
